description: Replacement-family sibling: Palavreado (order-independent bag-of-keywords) fills the keyword-high slot, Padatious backs it up at medium — identical shape and backup to mycroft-classic, which stands in for the Adapt side of this A/B.
notes: FAMILY: kw-slot A/B — mycroft-classic (adapt-high -> padatious-medium) vs kw-slot-palavreado (palavreado-high -> padatious-medium). There is no separate kw-slot-adapt fighter: that config is identical to mycroft-classic (adapt-high -> padatious-medium), and per the 1-fighter-per-config rule mycroft-classic itself now serves as the 'keyword engine = adapt' side of this A/B rather than duplicating the same pipeline under a second competitor_id. This sibling swaps only the keyword-high engine (Palavreado in for Adapt); backup engine and tier (padatious-medium) held fixed against mycroft-classic. Isolates whether Adapt's stricter ordered require/optional grammar or Palavreado's looser order-independent bag-of-keywords matching makes a better front-door gate ahead of an identical Padatious backstop.
